subject.title: Centralize chat-session naming; define subagent session lifetime & cross-channel persistence

question: What is the canonical session identity contract for ACP and native subagent sessions: title source and precedence, persistent-vs-run lifetime, cleanup/archive ownership, and cross-channel binding scope?
rationale: The remaining work crosses persisted session state, ACP runtime semantics, native subagent behavior, channel binding rules, and companion display contracts, so automation should not choose the product/API contract alone.

options.title: Define Core Contract First
options.body: Set the naming, lifetime, cleanup, and cross-channel persistence contract in core/Gateway first, then implement the smallest compatible code and docs updates.

options.title: Split Naming From Lifecycle
options.body: Track title/source-of-truth work through the naming and auto-title items while keeping this issue focused on ACP/subagent lifecycle and persistence semantics.

options.title: Limit Core To Current Pieces
options.body: Keep existing docs and runtime behavior, route UI clutter to companion apps, and only revisit core when a narrower missing API is identified.

recommendation.title: Define Core Contract First
recommendation.body: Set the naming, lifetime, cleanup, and cross-channel persistence contract in core/Gateway first, then implement the smallest compatible code and docs updates.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest product-routing signal from the related Windows issue and merged current session-area changes.
